name: Higuchi Shouji
source:
Shinobu’s best friend. He’s sharp-tongued, but his personality is straightforward and driven by impulse. He’s well known around town and has a knack for picking up information. Having grown up with few friends and distant family ties, he treats the circle of seven as something almost sacred. He places especially deep trust and loyalty in Shinobu, but he genuinely cares about every one of them. If anyone were to threaten that bond, Shoji has both the will and the strength to remove them without hesitation. Loves meat. A true carnivore.

[From the [https://web.archive.org/web/20240521122532/https://xuse.co.jp/product/053_farthest2015/pageCharacter.html]official site[/url].]
